description: Hand-written paraphrases of REAL JEE Advanced 2023 questions, in the two ways leaked questions actually get rewritten: (1) a clean English paraphrase that keeps the meaning but changes the wording, (2) a Hinglish/shorthand student retype, often with the answer attached. Used ONLY as an evaluation set for the content matcher and to generate hard 'paraphrased leak' sessions -- no model is trained on it.
annotator: Written by an AI assistant (Claude) acting as annotator, from the question text in JEEBench. Not collected from any real leak channel.
source_questions: JEEBench (Arora et al., EMNLP 2023, MIT licence)

items.text: S is the union of the open intervals (0,1), (1,2) and (3,4), and T is the set {0,1,2,3}. Decide which claims about functions from S into T hold: infinitely many functions, infinitely many strictly increasing ones, at most 120 continuous ones, every continuous one differentiable.
